mentions.name: Simcarlo
mentions.description: A web-based Monte Carlo simulator with a visual, node-based editor for building supply chain models. It shows the full spectrum of potential outcomes instead of a single guess.
mentions.problem: Point estimates give only a single guess rather than the full range of potential outcomes.
mentions.audience: Supply chain professionals modeling uncertainty in their work
mentions.source_excerpt: For my work I've developed a web-based Monte Carlo simulator with a visual, node-based editor for building supply chain models. Last week, I started making it available for everyone.

evidence.value: For my work I've developed a web-based Monte Carlo simulator with a visual, node-based editor for building supply chain models. Last week, I started making it available for everyone.
